errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across a range of media outlets. The chart contains twelve distinct slices, representing twelve different news sources.
The largest slice, colored blue, represents “Breitbart” with approximately 14%, followed by “Shareblue” at approximately 13% and “Fox News” at approximately 13%.
errors.evidence: The chart displays raw counts inside slices (e.g., Breitbart 14, Other 13), not percentages. The blue Breitbart slice is 14 counts and the gray Other slice is 13 counts; Shareblue and Fox News are both 3, not 13%.
